# Teddy bear: pink fur, white snout, dark eyes, 0.72 m tall. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Fur --base-color 1.0000 0.5255 0.5255 --no-slot
material new Snout --base-color 0.9922 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.3255 0.0118 0.2941 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.21 --location 0.000 0.000 0.210
scale 1 0.9 1.05
apply --scale
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.17 --location 0.000 -0.020 0.500
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name EarL --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.075 --location -0.130 0.000 0.640
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name EarR --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.075 --location 0.130 0.000 0.640
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name ArmL --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.085 --location -0.200 -0.080 0.270
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name ArmR --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.085 --location 0.200 -0.080 0.270
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name LegL --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.09 --location -0.120 -0.120 0.070
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name LegR --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.09 --location 0.120 -0.120 0.070
material assign Fur
add mesh ico-sphere --name Snout --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.08 --location 0.000 -0.160 0.450
material assign Snout
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 0.06 --location -0.070 -0.160 0.550
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 0.06 --location 0.070 -0.160 0.550
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export bear.glb
